passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is my new notebook, and the cover is green.
phrases.ko: 이것은 나의 새 공책이고, 표지는 초록색이에요.
phrases.zh: 这是我的新笔记本，封面是绿色的。
phrases.py: zhè shì wǒ de xīn bǐ jì běn， fēng miàn shì lǜ sè de。

phrases.en: I write an English word, and I draw a small picture.
phrases.ko: 나는 영어 단어를 쓰고, 작은 그림을 그려요.
phrases.zh: 我写一个英语单词，再画一幅小图画。
phrases.py: wǒ xiě yí gè yīng yǔ dān cí， zài huà yī fú xiǎo tú huà。
wǒ bǎ zì xiě de hěn zhěng qí。

phrases.en: I bring it to school every day.
phrases.py: wǒ měi tiān bǎ tā dài dào xué xiào。

phrases.zh: 我的笔记本帮助我学习。
phrases.py: wǒ de bǐ jì běn bāng zhù wǒ xué xí。

phrases.en: The new cover is easy to find in my bag.
phrases.ko: 새 표지는 가방 안에서 찾기 쉬워요.
phrases.zh: 新封面在书包里很容易找到。
phrases.py: xīn fēng miàn zài shū bāo lǐ hěn róng yì zhǎo dào。

phrases.en: Each English word has a picture beside it.
phrases.zh: 每个英语单词旁边都有一幅图画。
phrases.py: měi gè yīng yǔ dān cí páng biān dōu yǒu yī fú tú huà。

phrases.en: Neat writing helps me read my notes.
phrases.ko: 깔끔한 글씨는 내가 노트를 읽도록 도와줘요.
phrases.zh: 整齐的字帮助我看自己的笔记。
phrases.py: zhěng qí de zì bāng zhù wǒ kàn zì jǐ de bǐ jì。

phrases.en: I write at school and also at home.
phrases.py: wǒ zài xué xiào xiě， yě zài jiā xiě。

phrases.en: A green notebook is my favorite one.
phrases.ko: 초록색 공책은 내가 가장 좋아하는 공책이에요.
phrases.zh: 绿色笔记本是我最喜欢的一本。
phrases.py: lǜ sè bǐ jì běn shì wǒ zuì xǐ huān de yī běn。

phrases.en: I take care of it because it is new.
phrases.zh: 它是新的，所以我好好爱护它。
phrases.py: tā shì xīn de， suǒ yǐ wǒ hǎo hǎo ài hù tā。

full_passage_spoken: This is my new notebook, and the cover is green. I write an English word, and I draw a small picture. I keep my writing neat. I bring it to school every day. My notebook helps me learn. The new cover is easy to find in my bag. Each English word has a picture beside it. Neat writing helps me read my notes. I write at school and also at home. A green notebook is my favorite one. I take care of it because it is new.
full_passage_zh: 这是我的新笔记本，封面是绿色的。我写一个英语单词，再画一幅小图画。我把字写得很整齐。我每天把它带到学校。我的笔记本帮助我学习。新封面在书包里很容易找到。每个英语单词旁边都有一幅图画。整齐的字帮助我看自己的笔记。我在学校写，也在家写。绿色笔记本是我最喜欢的一本。它是新的，所以我好好爱护它。
